svg.aria-label: Who may do what on a normal day: reads run for you everywhere; writes ask first in the app and wait for your OK from your phone, Discord or a connected app; friends and strangers get almost nothing
svg.title: Who may do what on a normal day: reads run for you everywhere; writes ask first in the app and wait for your OK from your phone, Discord or a connected app; friends and strangers get almost nothing

g.text: WHO MAY DO WHAT, ON A NORMAL DAY
The default settings of a new hub, from the permission table v0.99.14 is tested against.
Asks first: you are at the screen and press OK there and then. Waits for OK: it becomes an approval on Today and on your phone.
Within cap: your own-transfer cap and spend caps decide; with no cap set, it waits for you.
